How it works

Complete Multigrain Flour Process Flow

Raw Material Handling & Storage

Various grains, pulses, and seeds are received and stored separately.

Material Handling SystemsStorage Silos / Bins

➜ Ensures organized and controlled processing.

Cleaning & Pre-Processing

Each raw material is cleaned to remove impurities.

Pre CleanerDestonerMagnetic SeparatorAir Classifier

➜ Ensures:

  • High product purity
  • Food safety compliance
Roasting / Heat Treatment (OPTIONAL)

Certain ingredients like chana dal, soybean, and millets may be roasted.

RoasterContinuous Roasting System

➜ Ensures:

  • Improved flavor
  • Better digestibility
  • Reduced moisture
Grinding / Milling

Each ingredient is ground separately into flour.

PulverizerGrinding MachineHammer Mill

➜ Ensures:

  • Fine and uniform particle size
  • Ingredient-specific processing
Sieving & Classification

Ground materials are sieved for uniform consistency.

Vibro SifterPlansifter

➜ Ensures consistent flour texture.

Blending

Different flours are blended in precise ratios.

Ribbon BlenderPaddle Mixer

➜ Ensures:

  • Uniform mixing
  • Consistent nutritional composition
  • Customized formulations
Fortification (OPTIONAL)

Vitamins, minerals, or additives may be added.

Dosing System
Dust Collection & Air Handling

Fine flour dust is controlled during grinding and mixing. Systems Used:

Dust CollectorCyclone Separator

➜ Ensures:

  • Clean environment
  • Product recovery
Quality Inspection

Final inspection ensures consistency and product quality.

Inspection Systems
Packaging (RETAIL & BULK)

Finished multigrain flour is packed into pouches or bags.

Form Fill Seal (FFS) MachineBag Filling MachineWeighing System

➜ Suitable for:

  • Retail packaging
  • Bulk supply
